title: CSS3 & Responsive Design - Part 1
description: CSS3 and responsive design fundamentals including selectors, box model, Flexbox, Grid, animations, media queries, and Tailwind CSS for building visually appealing, mobile-ready layouts. This submodule covers: CSS fundamentals, Selectors, Colors, Typography, Box model, Display.
learning_outcomes: Apply CSS selectors and specificity rules
Style with colors, typography, and box model
Implement layouts with Flexbox and CSS Grid
